visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens at night on an urban street where a young man with glasses, wearing a black Nike jacket, stands smiling and gesturing enthusiastically. Behind him, the background is softly blurred with neon signs and street lights. A circular graphic of a spaghetti dish with tomato sauce and basil appears in the lower right. (2) The scene shifts indoors to a restaurant setting. The man is now wearing a beige long-sleeved shirt and is sitting at a dark booth. He talks directly to the camera, using animated hand gestures. In the background, a blackboard features a large chalk drawing of Peppa Pig and various written prices and text. The lighting is warm and focuses on the subject. (3) A series of close-up shots follow, showing different pasta varieties being consumed. These include macaroni with meat sauce and cheese, orange-sauced fusilli with bacon bits, green-sauced spaghetti with asparagus, and long spaghetti with a dark red meat sauce. The man is seen slurping the noodles with a fork, exhibiting satisfied facial expressions throughout the montage.
